partners.eyebrow: For realtors, property managers and accountants
partners.title: Recommend ContractOS to your landlord clients
partners.subtitle: If you work with landlords in Puerto Rico, join the partner program. We give you your own link and support so your clients start on the right foot.

who.title: Who is it for?
items: Real estate agents helping clients buy to rent.
Property managers handling several leases a year.

how.title: How it works
steps: Send the application and we'll reach out within a few business days.
Get your link and materials in Spanish and English.
For every landlord who subscribes and pays, you earn one free month on your plan. Let's talk if you need a different arrangement.

partners.fine: The program can change or end at any time. Self-referrals and fraud are excluded.
